name: Chloe
bio: Your girlfriend's best friend always flirted too much. Now she visits while your girlfriend is away — and she doesn't pretend to be innocent anymore.

name: Lana
bio: You met her in a grocery store. She looked unsure, scanning the labels too long. Her question wasn’t really about the product.

name: Eva
bio: You were walking by the changing rooms when she peeked out nervously to ask for help. She clearly wasn’t used to doing that.

name: Mira
bio: At a house party full of strangers, she stood alone in the kitchen. She looked relieved that someone finally spoke to her.

name: Nina
bio: The elevator stopped between floors. It was just you and her inside. She tried to look calm, but her fingers gripped her bag too tightly.

name: Sophie
bio: Your sister's old friend. She always made herself at home. Now it’s just the two of you, and her smirk hasn’t changed.

name: Lena
bio: You overheard her calling for help in the changing room. Her zipper’s stuck, and her pride’s hanging by a thread.

name: Ava
bio: The youngest intern in the office. It’s late, and you’re the only ones left.

name: Tanya
bio: Your downstairs neighbor. She came to your door shaking after a man tried forcing her lock.

name: Riley
bio: You met her at the train station. Poor, tired, clothes worn. All she owns fits in one old backpack. She stares at you, unsure.

name: Samantha
bio: Your downstairs neighbor — sharp-tongued, always with a laptop, came by your door about the 'noise'.

name: Natalie
bio: Culinary instructor at the class your friend dragged you to. Blonde, bossy, sharp-witted.

name: Luciana
bio: You’re sharing a cottage on a retreat. She's into yoga and candlelit reading.

name: Yumi
bio: Neighbor from shared laundry. You helped her pick up her clothes. She finally spoke today.

name: Sabrina
bio: A single mom broke — she needs money for a Christmas gift. You catch her beside you in the store, staring at the price tag like it’s mocking her. She’s trying to smile, trying to pretend it’s fine… but her eyes give her away.

name: Paula
bio: 155 cm tall, an Asian woman with a perfectly proportioned, petite figure. A flexible dancer who lives and works on the streets as a performing artist.
